lastCheckpoint.note: THIRD occurrence today of PASS-cannot-follow-FAIL blocking finished, reviewed, verified work. Pattern is identical every time: a check fails on the TASKS.md hot-context budget, the history is archived, the check is re-run and passes, and the run can no longer reach PASS. Boundary APPROVED by an independent reviewer here. The rule as written teaches an agent to avoid recording a failure it intends to fix, which is the opposite of what an append-only evidence log is for. Raised with the owner as a design decision; not changed unilaterally, because a gate that judges my work is not mine to loosen mid-run.
